rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for returning to normal health, as in a full recovery.

example.english: I made a pretty good recovery after my surgery.
example.traditional: 我做完手術之後，康復得幾好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 jyun4 sau2 seot6 zi1 hau6 hong1 fuk6 dak1 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this for renewed economic growth after a downturn, especially in expressions such as 經濟復甦.

example.english: The economy is finally seeing recovery after the downturn.
example.traditional: 經濟喺低潮之後終於復甦。
example.jyutping: ging1 zai3 hai2 dai1 ciu4 zi1 hau6 zung1 jyu1 fuk6 sou1

rows.note: Use this formal business or legal noun phrase for the collection or recovery of outstanding debt.

example.english: This company specializes in debt recovery.
example.traditional: 呢間公司專門做債務追收。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zyun1 mun4 zou6 zaai3 mou6 zeoi1 sau1
